method: County-constrained 2019 WorldPop spatial allocation of official KNBS 2019 county census totals.

publication_gate.cell_rule: A constituency/ward candidate is promotion-eligible only when both variants allocate a positive value and absolute constrained-vs-unconstrained spread divided by their mean is <= 50%. Cells failing this stability gate remain unavailable; thresholds are not relaxed after results are seen.
